name: CashCowCoin trading proxy sell() burns CCC from the pair and syncs
summary: CashCowCoin's public trading proxy sell() swaps the caller's CCC for WBNB through the CCC/WBNB PancakeSwap pair. It then calls the token's proxy-only function 0xb20a0b6f to burn the CCC that just arrived in the pair to 0xdead, and calls pair.sync(). Each sell therefore takes WBNB while the pair's CCC reserve stays flat. With a Moolah flash loan the attacker bought 8.8M CCC and ran 80 sells, draining the pair's WBNB reserve from 165.49 to 0.018.

loss.notes: WBNB depletion of the CCC/WBNB pair 0x1dbe9458a6840784d5defd62c6b71386100097c0 across the exploit transaction; the attacker's 13,999.89 WBNB donation and flash-loaned buy are returned within the same transaction and cancel out. It equals the attacker's net 165.4719 WBNB. The pair's CCC is not valued because the drained pair was its market.

ageReset.description: The fourth Upgraded event installed implementation 0x4287742e, whose sell() calls the token burn and pair.sync(); a fifth Upgraded event at block 118208181 re-selected the same implementation.

limitations: Not the latest age reset: the token authorized this proxy for the pair burn in source-5, after this implementation change.
Implementation and token bytecode are unverified; sell() behaviour is established from the call trace.

ageReset.description: Token owner 0x417ce43e called 0x497b15d1(trading proxy), setting mapping slot 29 [proxy] = 1, the gate of burn function 0xb20a0b6f. With that entry cleared, the burn from the proxy reverts ("t,a,").

limitations: Token bytecode is unverified; the gate slot is identified by storage diff and state-override eth_call.

sources.note: Root cause, targets and anchor. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 118384061, index 86, EOA 0x7977bdee calling helper 0x7738b4d7): 80 CALLs from trading proxy 0xf523224c6171f81c54b93f474ed4c78de91241c7 to CCC token 0xb9b845f718c32f37e8af8b887ae4eec816c93ccc with selector 0xb20a0b6f(pair 0x1dbe9458..., 0xdead, amount), each inside a proxy sell() after the CCC->WBNB swap and followed by pair.sync(). eth_call of 0xb20a0b6f(pair, 0xdead, 1e6) at block 118384060 succeeds from the proxy, reverts "t,a," from 0x...beef, and reverts from the proxy with a stateOverride of token slot keccak256(proxy . 29) = 0x60d4e528...f974 set to 0. That slot was 0 at block 118208387 and 1 at 118208388 and 118384060, written in source-5 (118208388:103, owner 0x417ce43e, input 0x497b15d1(proxy); prestateTracer diff also sets slot 0x1c = proxy and keccak256(proxy . 27) = 1, neither of which gates the burn). Age: eth_getLogs of Upgraded on the proxy from its creation (source-2, block 117399306:82, creator 0xecee41cb) give five events: 0x8baf3e27 (117399306), 0xaca751c9 (118150038), 0x071bbe41 (118160934), 0x4287742e (source-3, 118205914:83, log 3906) and 0x4287742e again (118208181). The EIP-1967 slot is 0x4287742e at 118384060; implementation created at 118205896 (tx 0x0fce28de3473aca68ffd0cd183f8ecb0595b9ec972c8b0ca9b4a6fbafb3355c6 index 122, creator 0xecee41cb), code empty at 118205895, keccak256(runtime) = 0xa5924a75...1a7b at 118205896 and 118384060. Token created in source-4 (118205628:114), code empty at 118205627, keccak256(runtime) = 0xb63fb4e6...0d78 at 118205628 and 118384060. Earliest exercise: eth_getLogs of CCC Transfer(pair -> 0xdead) from block 118208388 to 118384200 gives 85 burns in 6 transactions: five ordinary single sells with one burn each, and the 80 burns of source-1, the first multi-cycle drain.
